text:
maya_k: Heads up — candidate Alex T. for SRE panel next Tue had a conflict. Can we either shift 10:00 -> 11:00 or swap a panelist? Panel currently: elena, david_h, becca, samir. Also need someone to pick up PR review for the takehome before debrief: https://git.redwood.ai/pr/4821

samir: I can cover the 10:00 slot if David can't. Which slot would I replace?

david_h: I’m out on PTO that week, so can't cover. Maya — did candidate confirm any flexibility?

maya_k: Alex said 11:00 works if we want to shift it. If shifting is hard, Samir can step in at 10:00.

elena: I can move to 11:00 but quick rubric check — still infra debugging 60 / system design 40, right?

maya_k: Yup, rubric v3: infra 60%, design 40%. Use the v3 scorecard and call out any edge cases in comments.

becca: Quick: who owns PR 4821 review? We should get that done before debrief.

david_h: assigning to @rebecca (she's been looking at takehomes recently)

rebecca: I’ll do a quick pass now — expect comments by EOD.

samir: I’ll take the 11:00 slot and can scribe notes for debrief.

maya_k: Awesome — debrief reminder: please submit scorecard within 24h. Minimal checklist in case folks want a copy:

```
- fill scorecard (rubric v3)
- 3 bullets: top pros / top cons
- flag any security/culture concerns explicitly
```

rebecca: PR review done — left 2 tiny nits and asked for one extra unit test. No blockers.

maya_k: Also small ops note: use the "candidate-livestream" room and enable captions. @deploy-bot can you reserve 11:00-12:00?

deploy-bot: room candidate-livestream reserved 2024-11-12 11:00-12:00 UTC :white_check_mark:

elena: One rubric edge-case question — if they nail infra debugging but are weak on design, do we average or gate?

maya_k: Follow rubric v3: score = infra*0.6 + design*0.4. If one area is far below hire threshold, add a comment recommending hold. Don’t average away major misses.

david_h: +1 to that approach.

becca: I’ll draft debrief bullets after the panel and ping QE if perf followup is needed.

maya_k: Thanks everyone — tagging for visibility: @samir @elena @becca @david_h @rebecca. If anything changes, reply here so I can update candidate and interview calendar.
